speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: My lord bids me say (and I soften it) that he is content.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear you. I am not going to add a speech to his content.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: You will be sent for. Whether you will be paid for is a question for another office. This purse is not that question.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: The purse is my lord's own, not the Chamber's. Four pounds, for hose. Twelfth Day you are looked for again. I am not leaving Twelfth Day's money on this barrel. There is none in my hand to leave.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Four pounds. Eight parts of ten shillings. I will divide it here, and I will not read the names out.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Call the whole of it hose and put it on one leaf, and let us go to the boat as if the Queen had paid us.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I will not. My lord's purse goes on one leaf, received. The Queen's three nights go on another, expected. An office is still empty. Empty is not a number I can divide.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not arguing the distinction. I have ten shillings, and I know which purse they came from.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Two cloaks. The yeoman has them back. The count is in this light, not last night's.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: He did not speak. Good. A count can be silent and still be a count. Nick is not singing the river. A new voice is not a catch for a tide.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Ten shillings. I have mine. I am not going to make a speech over a barrel-head.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then nobody is merry. My lord is content, the Queen is a vacant office, and I am to be looked for on Twelfth Day. A date is not a pudding.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Twelfth Day is the date I was told to leave with you. I have left it. Content is the word I was told to soften, and I have softened it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will not hear it improved by me. Thank my lord. I have no argument to send back with you.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nothing of the three nights goes back either, because nothing of them has come.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The cloaks are done. Two. I do not want them in the boat.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The boys are with me when we go down. No verse.

speaker: will_kemp
text: God keep the ebb. My story is for an inn, and this is the wrong inn.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eight parts. I have them down. We are for the boat, and I am not opening the book again before Old Swan.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Mine is in my hand. That is as much name as I need on a green.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have my ten shillings. I am not counting anyone else's.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Then I am for my lord, and you are for the ebb. God keep you.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The yeoman is gone, and the two cloaks with him. I am satisfied.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No humming on the water. Humming is a try. Come.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not starting a head on a barrel. The ears can wait until I am off this green.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not start it here. The boat is the next thing, and the boat can be a boat.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The wrong inn. Remember you said it. God keep you.
